# French Nail Spa

> Nails, waxing & hot stone based in Bloomington, Indiana. Gel manicures, full acrylic sets and fills, French tips, nail art and pedicures at 601 N College Ave, plus waxing and hot stone. Sweet, patient techs who check in the whole time and take their time on every set.

- Phone: (812) 822-0422
- Based in: Bloomington, IN
- Nearby areas: Bloomington, Ellettsville, Bedford, Martinsville, Spencer
- Google rating: 4.3 from 40 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/indiana/french-nail-spa/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/indiana/french-nail-spa/book.html

## Services
- Manicures & gel: Classic or gel polish, shaped and finished clean, in any shade off the color wall.
- Full acrylic sets & fills: Full sets for you and your friends, from simple and clean to ombre, foil and stars. Fills too.
- French tips: The one we're named for: classic white tips, or black tips with glitter, pearls and rhinestones.
- Nail art: Accent nails, dots, swirls, stars and color pops, done by hand.
- Pedicures: Settle into one of the pedicure chairs along the front windows and put your feet up.
- Waxing & hot stone: It's right there on the sign: waxing and hot stone, in a quieter room at the back.

## About
French Nail Spa sits under a hot-pink sign at 601 N College Ave, in the brick building a few blocks north of the square. Students walk over from campus, locals stop in on the way home, and friends and moms come in together for matching sets. Inside it's warm wood, brick and a full wall of polish colors, with manicure stations up front and pedicure chairs lined up along the windows. Clients talk about how clean it is from the moment they walk in. What reviewers mention most is the people: techs who are sweet and professional, keep asking if you like it and if you're comfortable, and take their time on your nails. Our promise is simple: we will always make you feel comfortable, and we're patient with every client.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes, walk in any time we're open. To be sure of a chair, especially for a group, call (812) 822-0422 or book here first.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Friday 10 am to 7 pm, Saturday 9:30 am to 6 pm, closed Sunday. Holiday hours can differ, so call ahead.
- Q: Where are you, and where do I park?
  A: 601 N College Ave, Bloomington, IN 47404, in the brick building with the hot-pink French Nail Spa sign, a few blocks north of the square. Street parking is nearby.
- Q: Can my friends and I come in together?
  A: Absolutely. Groups of friends and moms-and-daughters come in together all the time. Call ahead for three or more so we can have chairs ready.
- Q: Do you do French tips and nail art?
  A: Yes. Classic white French, black or glitter tips, pearls and rhinestones, and hand-painted art. Bring a photo of what you want.
- Q: Do you do fills and polish changes?
  A: Yes. Acrylic fills, repairs, gel color changes and polish removal. Walk in or call ahead.
- Q: Do you offer waxing?
  A: Yes. Waxing and hot stone are both on our sign. Call (812) 822-0422 to ask about a specific service.
